instructions:
Romanian business data for AI agents: the official ONRC company registry (4.2M companies), Ministry of Finance filings, and website/domain enrichment, all from Romanian government open data loaded locally.

Which tool: lookup_business for a company by name or CUI (start here); lookup_director when you know a person; lookup_by_category to find companies by activity rather than name; extract_contacts or lookup_domain for a website; lookup_financials and lookup_financial_ratios for money; enrich_company for one company's full profile in a single call. watch_company and watch_caen register monitors, poll_watchlist returns what changed and lists the watches you hold, and unwatch removes one.

Search is diacritic-insensitive: pass plain ASCII ('paval' matches 'PAVAL').

Cite the date: every company result, list, financial answer and watch carries asOf {registry, financialYear, anaf}. When you quote registry data, say it is as of the ONRC snapshot of asOf.registry (e.g. 'as of the ONRC snapshot of 2 Sept 2026'); name asOf.financialYear with figures and asOf.anaf with VAT or inactive status.

Coverage: a first look, not a full check. risk.level 'ok' only means no distress signal in the ONRC statuses and ANAF flags held; the insolvency bulletin (BPI), ANAF tax debts, court cases and shareholders are not checked (risk.notChecked; https://leadgen.adrianhomelab.com/en/coverage?src=mcp-instructions). Never call a company clean, safe or solvent on this data alone: say what was not checked.

Links to pass on: a company result carries url, its public record page, to share with your user; a lookup_by_category list carries appUrl, which opens the same list in the Leadgen app.

Limits: 30 anonymous MCP calls a day, 50 with a free API key - an email address, no payment - from https://leadgen.adrianhomelab.com/start?src=mcp-instructions. get_usage shows what is left today (free, not counted): tool results carry the allowance only in their _meta (leadgen/usage), which many clients do not show you, so call get_usage when you need the remaining count, e.g. before a long batch. Answers with an error are not counted. report_issue reports what is missing or wrong to the person who runs Leadgen (free, not counted). REST API docs: https://leadgen.adrianhomelab.com/docs?src=mcp-instructions

Plans: free during launch - every tool works within the limits above. When paid plans go live, full financial history, ratios and health score, financial filters (revenue, headcount, VAT) and CSV move to Pro (https://leadgen-checkout.adrianhomelab.com/?src=mcp-instructions); main_activity_only stays free.

tools.description: Look up a Romanian company by name, CUI or hostname in the ONRC registry of 4.2M companies: a hostname ('emag.ro') resolves the firm that owns the domain, or says it could not identify it. Names are diacritic-insensitive ('paval' finds 'PAVAL'); a CUI matches exactly. Live companies rank first (exact name, then words), closed ones after; county lifts. For 'companies that do X in Y', search by activity and county.

tools.description: Find companies by what they do, not by name: a curated topic ('software', 'retail'), plain words ('dentists', a CAEN class title; see matched) or CAEN codes ('4321,4322'; 6201 also finds Rev.3 6210). Narrow by one county or several; filter by revenue, headcount, VAT, main activity, registration date (registered_since/registered_until). active_only (default) drops dead and ANAF-inactive companies.

topic.description: What the companies do: a curated topic ('software', 'retail'), plain words for a trade ('dentists', 'stomatologie'), a CAEN class title in Romanian or English, or CAEN codes ('6201' or '4321,4322'). Case-, space- and diacritic-insensitive. A number that names another activity in each revision takes a suffix: '4781r3' (Rev.3) or '4781r2' (Rev.2).
topic.title: Topic

county.description: Optional county to narrow to (diacritic-insensitive: 'bucuresti', 'cluj'; a county town such as 'Cluj-Napoca' or a Bucharest sector is read as its county); omit for nationwide. Several counties: a list (['Cluj', 'Iasi']) or one comma-separated string ('Cluj,Iasi'), the companies of any of them. An unknown county is an error (unknown_county) with suggestions, not 0 companies.
